data.name: Subtitle

data.value: Sign in to load the restaurant menu and your orders.

data.name: CancelConfirm
data.value: Cancel this order? Cancellation succeeds only if the kitchen has not started it.

data.name: ReplaceDraft
data.value: Replace the existing new order? Its unsaved contents will be discarded.

data.name: CloseUncertain
data.value: A request may already have been accepted. Closing loses its retry data. On your next sign-in, check existing orders before placing a replacement. Exit anyway?

data.name: CloseDirty
data.value: Closing will discard unsaved order edits. Exit?

data.name: Historical
data.value: This order uses an older menu. Its saved receipt and accepted totals are shown without repricing.

data.name: RepriceConfirm
data.value: Review this pending order using the current menu? Prices may change; nothing is sent until you click Update Order.

data.name: ChangedOnServer
data.value: The server order changed. Your edits are preserved but cannot be submitted until you reconcile them.

data.name: ReconcileConfirm
data.value: Keep your edits and review them against the latest pending revision? Select No to discard edits and load the saved order.

data.name: KitchenWon
data.value: The kitchen has started or closed this order. Your changes were not applied; the saved order is shown.

data.name: PendingTime
data.value: Cooking duration: {0} seconds (not queue wait time)

data.name: Unsaved
data.value: Unsaved changes — the receipt still shows the last accepted order.

data.name: UnconfirmedPrice
data.value: Server promo preview differs from the client total. Submission is blocked. Check menu/pricing parity before continuing.
